text: Diff-minimal autolayout: fix overlaps and tension by rewriting as few connection offsets as possible
description:
Layout state is the per-connection relativePosition (child offset from parent in units of radius sum); rendered positions emerge from springs + collisions. Multi-parent ideas and overlaps leave the stored offsets inconsistent.

Approach: solve node positions minimizing sum over connections of |realized offset - stored offset| (L1 / IRLS, robust) plus a non-overlap penalty. L1 makes residuals sparse: most connections stay exactly satisfied and keep their stored value; only connections with residual above a threshold are rewritten to their realized offset. Persist rounded offsets (2 decimals) so unchanged layouts produce no float-noise diffs. Show count of changed connections/files before persisting (toast/confirm, not window.confirm). Optional later: group penalty per parent file to minimize changed files.

Supersedes the angle-only Relax action (22851f87) as the main layout tool; Relax stays as an explicit "even spacing" mode.

status.comment: Graph toolbar 'Layout' button implemented and dry-run on the real graph; NOT persisted. First run would rewrite ~603 of 889 connections in ~192 files: Felix decides whether to accept that one-time diff.

reflection:
utils/autolayout.ts solveDiffMinimalLayout: start from positions implied by STORED offsets (roots/fixed ideas stay, descendants follow first parent), then IRLS on per-connection L1 residuals + sweep-and-prune overlap projection (clearance 1.2 radius sums, smaller idea moves more), 50 final separation passes. Only connections with residual > 5% of radius sum are rewritten, rounded to 2 decimals; drag saves and Relax now also round (kills float-noise diffs). GraphView: 'Layout' button, confirm shows N of M connections in K files, persists one update per parent; shared persistConnectionOffsets with Relax.

Real graph dry run (791 nodes, 889 links, ~220 ms): stored offsets alone place 363 ideas in hard overlap and 180 connections conflict (multi-parent/cycles); the rendered layout matches no stored offset within 5% (median residual 15 radius sums). Result: 0 hard overlaps, 603 changes / 192 files. Repeated runs: 603 -> 50 -> 16 (converging, not exactly idempotent: root positions are not stored, so components re-collide). Tighter keep-thresholds (0.02/0.01) were worse. Tests: autolayout.spec.ts (5: clean layout = 0 changes, overlapping subtree moves rigidly with only root connections rewritten, two-parent conflict = exactly 1 change, non-editable never rewritten, rounding). pnpm check 25/25.
